items.title_zh: 这家初创公司用 AI 开具痤疮处方
items.title_en: This startup is issuing AI-generated acne prescriptions
items.summary_zh: 医疗初创公司 Nolla Health 宣布，犹他州用户可通过其应用扫描面部，由 AI 系统分析痤疮严重程度并自动开具处方。该服务以试点形式推出，医生监督将逐步放宽：前 100 名患者每份 AI 处方需两名医生批准；到最多 500 名患者时，医生仅在处方开具后审核。这一尝试引发对 AI 自主开药监管边界的关注。
items.summary_en: People in Utah can now use AI to get a prescription for acne treatment. On Monday, healthcare startup Nolla Health announced that users in the state can scan their faces using its app, allowing its AI system to analyze acne severity and autonomously write a prescription, as reported earlier by Bloomberg . The service is launching as a pilot program with gradually loosening physician oversight. Two physicians will approve each AI-generated prescription before they're issued for the first 100 patients, but will start reviewing them only after they're prescribed for up to 500 patients. "After tha…
items.why_zh: 它标志着 AI 从辅助诊断迈向自主开处方，可能重塑医疗监管与责任归属。
items.why_en: It marks a step from AI-assisted diagnosis toward autonomous prescribing, potentially reshaping medical regulation and liability.

items.title_zh: Corgi Invest 推出 MN ETF，涵盖 OpenAI、Anthropic、SpaceX 及上市科技公司

items.summary_en: Corgi Invest Launches MN ETF With Exposure To OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX And Public Technology Companies Pulse 2.0
items.why_zh: 它为普通投资者提供了间接持有未上市 AI 明星公司敞口的工具。
items.why_en: It offers retail investors a way to gain indirect exposure to private AI leaders.

items.title_zh: AI 进军数学界引发争议：突破与反弹并存
items.title_en: All the drama around AI’s takeover of mathematics
items.summary_zh: 过去一年，OpenAI、Anthropic 等实验室宣称在多个长期悬而未决的数学问题上取得突破，部分成果甚至超出研究人员对当前系统的预期，包括解决了一个著名的千禧年大奖难题。但 AI 实验室以典型的硅谷方式快速推进，如同失控的推土机碾过这一学科，本应受到赞誉的成果反而引发强烈反弹。实验室表示正在从早先的错误中学习，但争议仍在持续。
items.summary_en: This past year, OpenAI, Anthropic, and other labs have announced breakthroughs on numerous long-standing mathematical problems, in some cases pushing well beyond what researchers expected current systems to be capable of — including resolving one of the famous Millennium Prize problems. But in classic Silicon Valley style, AI labs are moving fast and breaking things , barreling through the discipline with all the grace of a runaway bulldozer . Results that might normally have been celebrated have instead sparked backlash . AI labs say they are learning from earlier mistakes. Whether those prom…
items.why_zh: 它凸显了 AI 在基础科学领域快速扩张与学术规范、信任之间的紧张关系。
items.why_en: It highlights the tension between AI's rapid expansion into fundamental science and academic norms and trust.

items.title_zh: Reflection AI 发布开源模型，被称作西方对中国实验室的回应
items.title_en: Reflection AI unveils an open-source Western answer to Chinese labs

items.summary_en: Reflection AI unveils an open-source Western answer to Chinese labs Semafor
items.why_zh: 开源大模型正成为中美 AI 竞争的关键战场，谁掌握生态谁就掌握开发者。
items.why_en: Open-source frontier models are becoming a key battleground between US and Chinese AI labs.

items.title_zh: Instinct 把 AI 智能体带进群聊，没有账号的好友也能参与
items.title_en: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
items.summary_zh: Instinct 宣布推出群聊功能，让好友可以在同一个群里共同使用其 AI 智能体，用于规划旅行、安排拼车、协调活动等任务。公司表示个人账号仍保持独立，个人智能体在共享信息或代为执行操作前必须获得用户授权。即便是没有账号的好友也可以加入群聊参与协作，这是该产品把 AI 代理从个人助手扩展到多人场景的尝试。
items.summary_en: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.
items.why_zh: AI 智能体从个人助手走向多人协作，是代理式 AI 社交化的重要一步。
items.why_en: Moving AI agents from personal assistants to shared, multi-user settings is a step toward social agentic AI.

items.summary_en: EPAM Launches Frontier AI Services for Complex Enterprise Workflows HPCwire

items.summary_en: SAS Launches AI Navigator for Enterprise AI Governance HPCwire

items.title_zh: Sam Altman：AI 会带来“一些坏事”，但总体完全值得
items.title_en: Sam Altman says ‘some bad things’ will happen, but AI is totally worth it
items.summary_zh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 表示，AI 带来的好处将极其巨大，因此“世界应当接受过程中发生一些坏事”。他把黑客攻击、诈骗以及其他“坏事”列为社会应当容忍的代价，理由是“人们会用 AI 做出多出好几个数量级的好事”，但他并未具体阐释这些潜在收益。此番表态正值 OpenAI 推动对 AI 采取“更轻触”的监管方式，而外界对前沿模型安全的担忧不断升温，部分担忧源于该公司多次未能阻止其日益强大的模型被滥用。
items.summary_en: Sam Altman thinks that the benefits of AI will be so great that "the world should accept some bad things happening" along the way. The OpenAI CEO pointed to hacks, scams, and "other bad things" as costs society should expect to tolerate because "people will do tremendously orders of magnitude more good stuff" with AI, without elaborating on the potential benefits. His comments come as OpenAI pushes for a "lighter touch" approach to AI regulation amid intensifying anxiety over the safety of frontier models - fears fueled in part by the company's repeated failures to keep its increasingly capabl…
items.why_zh: 头部 AI 公司掌门人公开为“接受风险”背书，会直接影响监管辩论的走向。
items.why_en: A leading AI CEO publicly arguing to tolerate harms directly shapes the regulatory debate.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 将在欧盟为 ChatGPT 和 Codex 文本输出添加隐形水印
items.title_en: OpenAI to add invisible watermarks to ChatGPT and Codex text output in the EU
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 5 日消息，OpenAI 今日宣布，为配合《欧盟人工智能法案》的内容透明要求，未来几周将在欧盟地区符合条件的 ChatGPT 和 Codex 文本输出中加入机器可识别的隐形水印。 据介绍，文本水印技术名为 textGrain（文本粒水印） ，会在模型选词过程中嵌入不可见的统计信号。检测器通过识别该信号，判断一段文本是否带有 OpenAI 水印。 IT之家注意到，OpenAI 下一步将在欧盟推广文本水印。未来几周，团队将仅在欧盟所有计划中向符合条件的 ChatGPT 和 Codex 用户引入文本水印功能。值得一提的是，OpenAI 不会在发布时将文本水印设为全球默认。 OpenAI 将为 API 客户启用选择加入的水印功能。从今天起，全球的 API 客户将能够选择为部分模型添加水印文本输出。这让客户能够决定水印如何符合其透明度义务以及为用户提供的体验。团队还在与云合作伙伴合作，在未来几周内为通过其服务访问的 OpenAI 模型输出提供水印功能。 OpenAI 还将为研究人员和专家组织提供探测器访问，获批的研究人员和专家组织可以申请从今天开始。根据行为准则访问最初将根据具体情况逐案授予，以支持文本来源的评估和改进。该工具会报告是否检测到 OpenAI 水印，但不会透露用户身份或提示内容或对话内容。
items.summary_en: OpenAI will add invisible, machine-readable watermarks to eligible ChatGPT and Codex text output in the EU in the coming weeks to meet the EU AI Act's transparency requirements, using a technique called textGrain. Watermarking will not be on by default globally; API customers can opt in, and vetted researchers can request detector access.
items.why_zh: 这是主流大模型厂商首次为监管合规在生成文本中系统嵌入来源标识。
items.why_en: It marks a major model provider systematically embedding provenance signals in generated text for compliance.

items.why_en: It shows AI being embedded into cyber insurance risk assessment and prevention.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 推出与图像生成结果并排展示的可视化广告
items.title_en: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
items.summary_zh: 据 TechCrunch 报道，OpenAI 推出了新的可视化广告形式，广告会与图像生成结果一同出现。这一举措扩展了 ChatGPT 中的广告产品形态。报道未披露具体的投放范围、定价方式，以及广告是否会影响生成结果的更多细节。
items.summary_en: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results TechCrunch
items.why_zh: 广告变现是 ChatGPT 商业化的重要方向，也牵动用户对生成结果中立性的担忧。
items.why_en: Ad monetization is central to ChatGPT's business model and raises questions about neutrality of results.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 将在 ChatGPT 中推出全新图片广告形式，不会影响生成结果
items.title_en: OpenAI rolls out new image ads in ChatGPT, saying they won't affect results
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 5 日消息，OpenAI 今日宣布，将在 ChatGPT 中推出全新的图片广告形式，扩充广告效果衡量工具与合作生态，并研发新方案用于评估品牌适配性。 IT之家从官方介绍获悉， ChatGPT 每周覆盖 12 亿用户 ，是全球规模最大的原生 AI 消费平台。这款全新图片广告形式，能够帮助用户想象产品与服务如何融入日常生活。广告图片可以展示产品灵感、使用场景或是产品带来的体验，让用户认识新品牌、了解产品的独特优势，辅助消费决策。对广告主而言，这也创造了借助图片讲述品牌故事的新机会。 项目初期， 团队会在 ChatGPT 的图像生成功能中测试该广告样式 。广告会做清晰标注，和用户正在生成的图片相互独立。和我们其他广告形式一样，广告内容不会影响 ChatGPT 给出的回答。本次测试将于本月晚些时候在美国启动，首批会邀请部分广告主参与。 OpenAI 提到，全新图片广告形式，助力用户发掘产品服务、想象产品如何融入生活，也让广告主拥有更直观的视觉化品牌叙事方式。整体来看，ChatGPT 广告新增的效果衡量能力、品牌适配评估能力，帮助企业评估广告活动效果，对广告投放场景建立信心。以上所有功能都遵循广告原则： ChatGPT 的回答保持独立客观，用户对话隐私受保护，用户掌握自身使用体验的控制权 。 OpenAI 表示会持续迭代广告平台，推出新广告样式与能力，帮助企业以贴合用户需…
items.summary_en: OpenAI is rolling out a new image ad format in ChatGPT, initially tested inside its image generation feature in the US later this month with select advertisers. Ads will be clearly labeled, kept separate from user-generated images and won't affect ChatGPT's answers, the company says.
items.why_zh: 在 12 亿周活用户基础上试水图片广告，显示 OpenAI 正加速搭建广告业务。
items.why_en: Testing image ads on a 1.2-billion-weekly-user base shows OpenAI rapidly building an ad business.

items.title_zh: 开源工具 RemoveMacAI 可删除 macOS 上 12GB 的 Apple Intelligence 数据
items.title_en: An open-source tool lets you delete 12GB of Apple Intelligence data on macOS
items.summary_zh: 一款名为 RemoveMacAI 的新开源命令行工具，可在 macOS 上删除 Apple Intelligence 的本地模型数据，从而释放约 12GB 存储空间。此前 macOS 曾提供单一设置开关来禁用 Apple Intelligence，但该开关在 macOS 27 中被移除，模型仍保留在磁盘上，相关功能也被拆散到多个设置面板中。开发者称该工具本质上复现了旧开关的效果：删除模型并关闭相关功能。MacRumors 率先发现了该项目。
items.summary_en: Getting some extra storage space on your Mac could be as easy as deleting Apple's AI features with a new open-source command line tool called RemoveMacAI . There used to be a single Settings toggle for disabling Apple Intelligence , but that was removed in macOS 27. Now, the models stay on your disk, and the features are split up across different settings panes. As spotted earlier by MacRumors , the RemoveMacAI developer said in a post on Reddit that the tool essentially does what the old settings toggle did, deleting the models and turning the features off: You have to find about a dozen sett…
items.why_zh: 它让用户重新掌控本地 AI 模型占用的磁盘空间，也反映出苹果 AI 策略变化引发的用户反弹。
items.why_en: It restores user control over disk space consumed by on-device AI models, highlighting pushback against Apple's changing AI approach.

items.title_zh: 从预测到自主决策：预测分析迈入代理式 AI 时代
items.title_en: Bringing predictive analytics to the agentic AI era
items.summary_zh: 文章指出，到 2026 年，企业 AI 的核心问题已不再是预测模型能否超越统计预测，这一争论已有定论；真正的问题是如何让预测系统依据自身结论采取行动，同时不偏离业务意图。前沿已经从“预测”转向“自主决策”，领先者与落后者之间的差距正在扩大。Everest Group 合伙人 Vishal Gupta 表示，企业已经厌倦了向后看的视角，他们希望更具前瞻性。文章还提供了一份相关报告供下载。
items.summary_en: In 2026, the question for enterprise AI is no longer whether predictive models can outperform statistical forecasts—that argument is settled. The big question now is how to enable predictive systems to act on their own conclusions without drifting from business intent. The frontier has moved from prediction to autonomous decision making, and the gap between leaders and laggards is widening accordingly. “Enterprises are done with a backward-looking point of view; they want to be more forward-thinking,” says Vishal Gupta, partner at research firm Everest Group. items.why_zh: 它点明了企业 AI 竞争的关键转折：从预测能力转向可落地的自主决策能力。
items.why_en: It highlights the key enterprise AI shift from prediction accuracy to deployable autonomous decision-making.

items.title_zh: 统一 BERT-CNN-BiLSTM 框架：同时进行孟加拉语新闻标题分类与情感分析
items.title_en: A Unified BERT-CNN-BiLSTM Framework for Simultaneous Headline Classification and Sentiment Analysis of Bangla News

This helps us quickly understand the emotional tone of the news. This research presents a state-of-the-art approach to…
items.why_zh: 它为低资源语言的新闻理解提供了多任务统一方案，有助于媒体监测与内容分析。
items.why_en: It offers a unified multi-task approach for news understanding in a low-resource language, useful for media monitoring and content analysis.

items.title_zh: 先检测再回答：视觉语言模型中的“海市蜃楼”检测
items.title_en: Detect Before You Leap: Mirage Detection in Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 论文关注视觉语言模型（VLM）在缺乏相关视觉证据时仍给出自信答案的失败模式，并将其称为“mirage”（海市蜃楼）。研究提出“发布前检测”问题：判断 VLM 的回答应被放出还是扣留。作者提出模型无关的方法 TC-LIA（Text-Conditioned Layer-wise Internal Alignment），在冻结的 CLIP ViT-H/14 编码器各层中追踪问题与图像的对齐情况，综合最终相似度、后层 top-k 对齐、前后层增益与斜率等指标。摘要因截断未完整呈现实验结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.00435v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can produce confident answers without relevant visual evidence, a failure mode known as mirage (Asadi et al., 2026). We study pre-release mirage detection: deciding whether a VLM answer should be released or withheld. Our model-agnostic method, Text-Conditioned Layer-wise Internal Alignment (TC-LIA), tracks question-image alignment across the layers of a frozen CLIP ViT-H/14 encoder, summarizing patch-text alignment by final similarity, late-layer top-k alignment, early-to-late gain, and slope. TC-LIA is tr…
items.why_zh: 它针对多模态模型“幻觉”风险提出发布前拦截思路，对提升 VLM 可靠性有现实意义。
items.why_en: It offers a pre-release filtering approach to VLM hallucination risk, which matters for making multimodal models more trustworthy.

items.summary_en: An invisible, machine-readable watermark in text output is rolling out to ChatGPT and Codex, but only for users in the European Union at first. OpenAI says its textGrain watermarking "matched or exceeded" other approaches like Google DeepMind's SynthID for text, which is also the basis for the watermarking Anthropic announced in August . items.title_zh: 为生成式 AI 设计未来的用户反馈机制
items.title_en: Designing the Future of User Feedback for Generative AI
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文探讨如何设计生成式 AI 的用户反馈机制。作者指出，部署后的用户反馈是监测和改进生成式 AI 系统与功能的一种低成本、可扩展且具代表性的手段，做得好还能提升用户的参与度与信任度。尽管政府监管和行业指南都要求重视部署后的用户参与，但目前缺乏关于如何设计既对消费者可用、又能为产品团队提供可执行输入的反馈机制的指导。为此研究者开展了多阶段研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.02631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Post-deployment feedback from users can be a cost-effective, scalable, and representative means to monitor and improve generative AI systems and features. When implemented effectively, giving such feedback can increase users' engagement with and trust in GenAI systems. Government regulations and industry guidelines call for post-deployment user engagement, but there is little guidance on designing mechanisms that are usable for consumers and provide actionable input for product teams. We conducted a multi-phase study as a collaboration between ac…
items.why_zh: 在监管要求用户参与的背景下，缺乏可落地的反馈设计指南是生成式 AI 产品改进的关键短板。
items.why_en: With regulators pushing for user engagement, the lack of actionable feedback design guidance is a key gap for improving GenAI products.

items.title_zh: NegT2IBench：当否定改变画面，文本生成图像的极性基准
items.title_en: NegT2IBench: When Negation Changes the Picture. A Polarity Benchmark for Text-to-Image Models
items.summary_zh: 现有文本生成图像（T2I）基准主要衡量所要求的内容是否出现，却普遍忽视满足否定性约束的能力，例如生成“一个非红色的杯子”。测量否定比测量肯定式提示更具挑战，需要在提示设计和评测方法上格外谨慎。为此研究者提出 NegT2IBench，包含4800条提示，覆盖两类属性和四类关系，并按极性组织提示。该基准旨在补上 T2I 评测中长期缺失的一块。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03084v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models are judged by benchmarks that measure whether requested content appears, but these benchmarks largely overlook the complementary ability to satisfy negated constraints, for example, generating "a non-red cup." Measuring negation raises challenges not faced by affirmation-based benchmarks and requires careful prompt and evaluation design. We introduce NegT2IBench, a benchmark of 4,800 prompts covering two attribute types and four relation categories. Prompts are organized by polarity: the number of positive statements…
items.why_zh: 否定约束是衡量 T2I 模型真实理解能力的重要维度，该基准填补了评测空白。
items.why_en: Negation is a key test of true comprehension in T2I models, and this benchmark fills a gap in evaluation.

items.title_zh: 少采样、多认知：自监督的测试时特征获取
items.title_en: Measure Less, Know More: Self-Supervised Test-Time Feature Acquisition
items.summary_zh: 多模态与高维学习的发展让基础模型能够处理异构大规模数据，但在测试阶段获取全部特征或模态往往代价高昂且冗余，因此在预测目标未知的情况下顺序选择有信息量的模态十分关键。研究者提出 ECHO-k，一种与任务无关、自监督的模态获取原则，利用深度模型内部预训练表示来指导选择。该工作为降低测试时数据采集成本提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03454v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent progress in multimodal, high-dimensional learning has enabled foundation models to process heterogeneous, large-scale data. However, at test time, acquiring all features or modalities can be prohibitively costly and often redundant. Sequentially selecting informative modalities is therefore critical, yet challenging when the downstream task or prediction target is unknown. To this end, we introduce ECHO-$k$, a task-agnostic and self-supervised learning principle for modality acquisition: we use a deep model's internal pretrained represen…
items.why_zh: 在不增加采集成本的前提下按需获取信息，对现实部署中的多模态系统尤为重要。
items.why_en: Acquiring only the information needed without extra cost matters greatly for deployed multimodal systems.

items.title_zh: 研究称分诊失误源于评测格式而非模型能力
items.title_en: Evaluation format, not model capability, drives measured triage failure in the assessment of consumer health AI
items.summary_zh: 一项 Nature Medicine 研究曾报告 ChatGPT Health 对51.6%的急症分诊不足，并据此认为面向消费者的 AI 分诊存在安全风险。该 arXiv 论文指出，其评测协议采用的是考试式框架（强制 A/B/C/D 输出、抑制知识、不允许追问），与消费者实际使用健康聊天机器人的方式不同。研究者因此追问：这一高错误率究竟属于模型本身，还是属于测量方式。首项机制性研究中，五个前沿大模型在17个场景题库上，采用更自然的患者风格提问时得分高出6.4分。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.11413v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A recent Nature Medicine study reported that ChatGPT Health under-triages 51.6% of emergencies and concluded that consumer-facing AI triage poses safety risks. Its protocol, however, was an exam-style scaffold (forced A/B/C/D output, knowledge suppression, no clarifying questions) unlike how consumers use health chatbots. We ask whether the headline error rate is a property of the models or of the measurement. In a first, mechanistic study, five frontier LLMs on a 17-scenario bank scored 6.4 points higher under naturalistic patient-styl…
items.why_zh: 它提醒人们，评测设计本身可能夸大甚至制造 AI 的安全风险结论。
items.why_en: It warns that benchmark design itself can inflate or even manufacture conclusions about AI safety risks.

items.title_zh: 训练出来的智能体式上下文管理
items.title_en: Trained Agentic Context Management
items.summary_zh: 该研究关注长上下文语言模型，但不采用原生长上下文训练，也不设计复杂的长上下文框架，而是让模型在最简单的工具框架上训练：一个用任意提示调用自身的工具，以及一个读取输入上下文指定区间 token 的工具。研究者在多样化的合成数据集上微调 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。结果显示，当文档长度超过4万 token 时，这个仅有8000 token 上下文的小模型在 OOLONG-synth 基准上可媲美拥有100万 token 上下文的 GPT-5.4。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.02404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study long context language models. Instead of training long context natively, or designing a long context harness, we train a model over the simplest possible harness: a tool to call itself with any specified prompt and a tool to read tokens in a range from the input context. We finetune Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on a diverse synthetic dataset using this harness. With only 8,000 tokens of context, our small model is as strong as GPT-5.4 with 1M tokens of context on the OOLONG-synth benchmark when document length exceeds 40K tokens.
items.why_zh: 它提示长上下文能力可以通过训练智能体式工具使用获得，而非单纯堆叠上下文窗口。
items.why_en: It suggests long-context ability can come from trained agentic tool use rather than a bigger context window alone.

items.title_zh: 用加性量化表示做上下文赌博机
items.title_en: Bandits via Additive Quantized Representations
items.summary_zh: 该论文针对上下文赌博机（contextual bandits）中非线性奖励建模与在线效率难以兼顾的问题，提出用残差量化（Residual Quantization, RQ）作为表示层。树集成与神经网络能刻画非线性，但需要周期性重训练并维护庞大的回放缓存；线性模型可以按观测以 O(1) 内存高效更新，却被限制在线性奖励结构之内。作者用离线训练的 RQ 码本把连续上下文映射为多个层级上的离散质心分配，并按需动态设定，从而在保留高效在线更新的同时引入非线性表达能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.02440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Contextual bandits require balancing nonlinear reward modeling with online efficiency. Tree ensembles and neural methods capture nonlinearities but require periodic retraining and large replay buffers. Linear models update efficiently per observation with O(1) memory, but are fundamentally restricted to linear reward structures. We propose Residual Quantization (RQ) as a representation layer to bridge this gap. An offline-trained RQ codebook maps continuous contexts into discrete centroid assignments across multiple levels, set dynamically throug…
items.why_zh: 为上下文赌博机提供了一条兼顾非线性表达与在线更新效率的折中路线。
items.why_en: It offers a middle path between nonlinear expressiveness and efficient online updates for contextual bandits.

items.title_zh: 面向更安全桥梁的智能感知：从传感器信号到 AI 异常检测
items.title_en: Smart Sensing for Safer Bridges: From Sensor Signals to AI-Driven Anomaly Detection
items.summary_zh: 桥梁对交通连通与城市发展至关重要，因此可靠的桥梁监测是保障公共安全、及早发现结构异常征兆的关键。论文研究真实桥梁传感器数据中的异常检测问题，采用两类互补方法：信号处理，以及数据驱动的机器学习模型 Isolation Forest。所用实时桥梁传感器数据采集自实际桥梁场景，目标是在异常行为可能预示结构状况恶化时尽早识别。摘要未给出具体检测性能结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03082v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bridges contribute significantly to transportation connectivity and urban development. Therefore, reliable bridge monitoring is crucial for protecting public safety and detecting anomalous behavior in bridge sensor data that may provide early indications of abnormal structural conditions. This paper investigates anomaly detection in real-world bridge sensor data using two different complementary approaches, namely signal processing and the data-driven machine learning model Isolation Forest. The real-time bridge sensor data is collected from an i…
items.why_zh: 桥梁结构异常若能被更早识别，将直接关系公共安全与交通基础设施的可靠运行。
items.why_en: Earlier detection of bridge anomalies directly bears on public safety and the reliability of transport infrastructure.

items.title_zh: LESSER：用输出层梯度做后训练数据选择
items.title_en: LESSER: Post-Training Data Selection with Output-Layer Gradients
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型后训练数据的选择会显著影响下游表现，基于梯度的数据选择是常见做法：按样本梯度与一小份验证集梯度的对齐程度对训练数据排序。然而用全参数梯度排序需要对每个样本做一次昂贵的反向传播，候选池一大就变得不可行。论文由此提出问题：能否以极低成本近似全梯度特征？作者发现输出层梯度可以胜任，并据此提出 LESSER 方法用于后训练数据选择。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03702v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The choice of post-training data for large language models substantially affects downstream performance. Gradient-based data selection is a popular approach that ranks training data by how well their gradients align with those of a small validation set. However, ranking with full-parameter gradients requires an expensive backward pass on every sample, making computation intractable for large candidate pools. This raises a natural question: can we approximate full-gradient features at a fraction of the cost? Conveniently, we find that output-layer…
items.why_zh: 若输出层梯度足以替代全参数梯度，大规模后训练数据筛选的成本将大幅下降。
items.why_en: If output-layer gradients can stand in for full-parameter gradients, large-scale post-training data curation becomes far cheaper.

items.title_zh: FASTDIAR：面向流式说话人分离的帧级编码器
items.title_en: FASTDIAR: Frame-level speaker encoder for Streaming Diarization
items.summary_zh: 实时对话智能体需要能够在 CPU 上运行的流式说话人分离（speaker diarization）。现有系统大多对高度重叠的短音频块套用话语级说话人编码器，既浪费算力，也让模型被优化到错误的任务上。论文改为把当前最先进的说话人识别架构改造成因果的帧级编码器：只需读取音频流一次，基于有界的两秒历史音频每 80 毫秒输出一个嵌入，并搭配在线聚类，每次更新都以自相似性作为门控条件。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.02941v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Real-time conversational agents require speaker diarization that streams and runs on a CPU. Most systems apply an utterance-level speaker encoder to short, heavily overlapping chunks, which wastes computation and leaves the model optimized for the wrong task. We instead turn a state-of-the-art speaker recognition architecture into a causal frame-level encoder that reads the stream once and emits one embedding every 80~ms from a bounded two-second window of past audio, and pair it with online clustering that gates every update on the self-simila…
items.why_zh: 帧级因果编码加在线聚类，让说话人分离能以更低算力在流式对话场景中落地。
items.why_en: A causal frame-level encoder with online clustering makes diarization practical for low-cost streaming conversational agents.

items.title_zh: 物理规律藏在激活值里吗？在视频扩散模型中定位物理量
items.title_en: Does Physics Live in the Activations? Localizing Physical Quantities in Video Diffusion Models
items.summary_zh: 视频生成模型能产出极其逼真的序列，并日益被提议用作世界模型，但近期基准测试显示它们在物理推理上存在明显短板。这引出一个问题：这些模型究竟内化了物理原理，还是只是复现熟悉的运动模式？论文通过探测视频 Diffusion Transformer（DiT）的内部表示来回答该问题，所用标签是仿真器给出的真值物理量，覆盖运动学运动以及重力与接触条件下的刚体动力学。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.03154v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Video generation models produce strikingly realistic sequences and are increasingly proposed as world models, yet recent benchmarks reveal pronounced deficits in their physical reasoning. This raises the question of whether these models internalize physical principles or merely reproduce familiar motion patterns. We address this by probing internal representations of video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for simulator-derived ground-truth physical quantities spanning kinematic motion and rigid-body dynamics under gravity and contact. We find that…
items.why_zh: 弄清视频模型是否真正编码物理量，是判断其能否充当世界模型的关键前提。
items.why_en: Determining whether video models actually encode physical quantities is essential to judging their viability as world models.

items.why_zh: 南向资金大幅加仓，显示内地资金对智谱这一 AI 标的的高度关注。
items.why_en: Heavy southbound inflows signal strong mainland investor attention on the AI company Zhipu.

items.summary_en: Sohu reports that Hong Kong stocks saw a broad pullback in September, yet Zhipu still attracted nearly HK$8 billion in southbound net buying. The stock thus gained mainland inflows against a weak overall market.
items.why_zh: 在市场整体回调的背景下仍获大额净买入，凸显智谱在资金配置中的相对吸引力。
items.why_en: Sustained heavy net buying during a market-wide pullback highlights Zhipu's relative appeal to mainland capital.

items.why_zh: 表明美国政治层面对AI发展的态度可能转向加速。
items.why_en: Signals a political shift toward accelerating AI rather than slowing it.

items.summary_en: DeepSeek open-sourced a full set of components for Huawei's Ascend, aiming at Nvidia's CUDA ecosystem. This could strengthen the Ascend software stack and reduce reliance on CUDA, potentially impacting the global AI computing landscape.
items.why_zh: 挑战英伟达CUDA垄断，推动国产AI芯片生态发展。
items.why_en: Challenges Nvidia's CUDA dominance and boosts domestic AI chip ecosystem.

items.summary_zh: 智谱万亿过山车：九个月从116到2980，再到626.5港元最高亏损79% 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: Zhipu experienced a wild stock ride over nine months, surging from 116 to 2980 then falling to 626.5 HKD, with losses reaching 79%. The extreme volatility highlights risks in AI-related investments.
items.why_zh: 凸显AI概念股或相关资产的极端波动风险。
items.why_en: Highlights extreme volatility risks in AI-related assets.

items.title_en: Zhipu's Nine-Month Rollercoaster: From 116 to 2,980 and Back to HK$626.5, a 79% Peak Drawdown
items.summary_zh: 智谱万亿过山车：九个月从116到2980，再到626.5港元最高亏损79% 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Chinese AI company Zhipu saw its shares swing from HK$116 to HK$2,980 and back down to HK$626.5 within nine months, a peak-to-trough decline of 79%, Sina Finance reported. The wild ride highlights how quickly sentiment around AI stocks can reverse. The report cites no specific business or financial figures behind the moves.
items.why_zh: 极端涨跌凸显AI概念股的情绪化定价与估值风险。
items.why_en: The extreme swing illustrates the sentiment-driven pricing and valuation risk in AI-themed stocks.

items.title_zh: a16z发布第七版《生成式AI消费应用Top 100》榜单
items.title_en: The Top 100 Gen AI Consumer Apps — 7th Edition
items.summary_zh: 风投机构 Andreessen Horowitz（a16z）发布了第七版“Top 100 Gen AI Consumer Apps”榜单，对面向消费者的生成式AI应用进行排名梳理。该系列榜单已成为观察消费级AI产品格局与竞争态势的常用参考。报道未提供本次榜单的具体名次、上榜产品变化或评选方法等细节。作为连续发布的第七版，其价值在于通过历次版本对比，呈现消费AI应用热度与格局的迁移轨迹。
items.summary_en: The Top 100 Gen AI Consumer Apps — 7th Edition Andreessen Horowitz
items.why_zh: 该榜单是观察消费级生成式AI产品兴衰与竞争格局的重要风向标。
items.why_en: The ranking is a key barometer of which consumer generative AI products are gaining or losing ground.

items.title_zh: OpenAI将在欧盟为ChatGPT生成的文本添加水印
items.title_en: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
items.summary_zh: 据 TechCrunch 报道，OpenAI 将开始在欧盟范围内为 ChatGPT 生成的文本加入水印标识，以便区分AI生成内容与人类写作内容。报道未说明具体实施时间、水印的技术形式或是否会影响输出质量。此举与全球监管机构要求AI生成内容可追溯、可识别的趋势一致，可能成为其他市场及模型厂商的参考做法。对用户而言，水印可能影响文本的二次使用、检测与合规判断。
items.summary_en: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU TechCrunch
items.why_zh: 头部模型厂商在监管压力下落实AI内容标识，将影响内容溯源与合规实践。
items.why_en: A leading model provider watermarking its output under regulatory pressure sets a precedent for AI content provenance and compliance.

items.title_zh: AI从何而来，又将走向何方
items.title_en: Where AI came from, to where it’s going
items.summary_zh: southeastarrow.com 刊文回顾人工智能的发展脉络，并展望其未来走向。文章以历史与趋势对照的方式，梳理AI从早期研究到当下热潮的演进，并讨论下一阶段可能的方向。由于原始摘要信息有限，文章的具体论点、引述人物与预测内容尚不明确。这类综述性内容的价值在于帮助读者建立对AI技术演进的整体框架，而非提供单一事件的最新进展。
items.summary_en: Where AI came from, to where it’s going southeastarrow.com
items.why_zh: 理解AI的历史脉络有助于理性判断当前热潮与未来预期。
items.why_en: Understanding AI's history provides context for judging today's hype and tomorrow's expectations.

items.title_zh: 企业AI的真正瓶颈出现在Demo之后
items.title_en: The Real Enterprise Bottleneck in Enterprise AI Comes After the Demo
items.summary_zh: HPCwire 刊文指出，企业落地AI的真正瓶颈并不在演示（Demo）阶段，而是在演示之后。文章关注的是概念验证顺利通过之后，企业如何把AI系统真正嵌入业务流程、数据管道与治理体系。摘要未提供具体案例、数据或解决方案细节。其核心提醒是：Demo 能证明技术可行，却无法证明可规模化、可维护、可合规地创造业务价值，后者才是企业AI成败的关键。
items.summary_en: The Real Enterprise Bottleneck in Enterprise AI Comes After the Demo HPCwire
items.why_zh: 提醒企业AI价值实现的关键在于Demo之后的规模化与治理，而非演示效果。
items.why_en: It highlights that value in enterprise AI depends on what happens after the demo — scaling, integration and governance.

items.title_zh: 特朗普任命宾州赫希地区出身的Jay Clayton领导新AI任务组
items.title_en: Trump appoints Hershey-area native Jay Clayton to lead new AI task force
items.summary_zh: 据 WGAL 报道，特朗普任命来自宾夕法尼亚州赫希地区的 Jay Clayton 领导一个新成立的AI任务组。报道未在摘要中说明该任务组的具体职责、成员构成或工作重点，也未披露相关任命是否需经确认程序。这条消息与近期美国联邦层面密集推出AI政策与机构安排的动作相呼应，反映AI治理正成为政治议程的一部分。对产业界而言，任务组的定位与权限将决定其对企业AI合规与政策环境的实际影响。
items.summary_en: Trump appoints Hershey-area native Jay Clayton to lead new AI task force WGAL
items.why_zh: 任务组人选落定，将影响美国AI政策走向及企业面对的监管环境。
items.why_en: Who leads the task force will shape U.S. AI policy direction and the regulatory environment for companies.

items.title_zh: AI热潮推动科技扩张，Sunnyvale一栋办公楼被收购
items.title_en: Sunnyvale office building is bought in wake of AI-fueled tech boom
items.summary_zh: 据 East Bay Times 报道，在AI带动的科技热潮背景下，加州 Sunnyvale 的一栋办公楼完成交易被收购。报道未在摘要中披露买家身份、成交金额或楼面面积等具体信息。该交易的背景是AI产业扩张带动相关地区办公与产业空间需求回暖，被视为科技地产情绪改善的一个信号。后续需关注类似交易的规模与持续性，以判断这轮需求是短期集中释放还是长期趋势。
items.summary_en: Sunnyvale office building is bought in wake of AI-fueled tech boom East Bay Times
items.why_zh: 反映AI产业扩张正外溢到商业地产，成为科技地产回暖的信号。
items.why_en: It shows AI-driven expansion spilling over into commercial real estate, a sign of recovery in tech property demand.
